prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1187; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is pursuing a claim for compensation.

Please be advised that all further communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, scheduling of examinations, and settlement discussions, must be directed exclusively to this office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you or any representative of your company.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any other coverage that may apply.

Finally, we demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dashcam or telematics data, vehicle event data, claim notes, recorded statements, adjuster files, and any other documents or electronically stored information. Please ensure that no such material is altered, discarded, or destroyed while this claim is pending.
